scope: Bridge replacement compensation, lost acknowledgments, completion gate/admission lock ordering, prior lifecycle ownership, and partial epoch cutover recovery

findings.boundary: Partial cutover followed by retry pause failure
findings.description: The first partial cutover leaves committed epochs and paused handoff barriers, but no irreversible phase survives the request. On a subsequent same-registration retry, a pause failure invokes restore_visual_assets_handoff and resumes earlier same-barrier nodes even though the prior attempt already committed cutovers. Preserve or detect irreversible cutover state across retries and test partial cutover followed by pause failure before successful recovery.

limits: Source/test review only; reported 35/35 tests not independently rerun.
